messages.author: Michael Owen
messages.body:
Dear Colleagues!
I am interested in D-glucosamine GLYCAM parameters, as opposed to NAc-D-glucosamine parameters.
Would you be so kind as to inform me as to whether D-glucosamine parameters are available for GLYCAM? If not, would you then kindly suggest how I can generate them?
Best regards,Michael Owen
Sent with [Proton Mail](
https://proton.me/
) secure email.
